findings.finding: Key: From sums: a+A=2(b+B) and a+A=b+B+10 ⇒ b+B=10, a+A=20. Let b∈[1,10], B=10−b; A∈[5,19], a=20−A. Solve aA=4bB and a(A−5)=b(B+5). Only integer solution: (a,b,A,B)=(10,5,10,5). Product a·b=50.

Set sums: a+A=2(b+B) and a+A=b+B+10 ⇒ b+B=10, a+A=20. Let X=a, u=b. Then Y=20−X, v=10−u. Solve X·Y=4u·v and X·(Y−5)=u·(v+5). Brute‑force X∈[1,15], u∈[1,10] → (X,Y,u,v)=(10,10,5,5). Ages product=10·5=50.
